player_prompt.intro:
Uyiyipleya {player_id} kuChopsticks. Kwixesha lakho, khetha eya kuzo:
  + Khwaza:  '[attack M O]'  lapho M=unyawo (0 okanye 1), O=unyawo lomdlali odala (0 okanye 1).
    - Inyawo lomdlali odala liphela ngunyawo; ukanti liphikiswe ku-5, liya ku-0.
  + Phathela:   '[split L R]'  ukuphatheleleza ngokwendlela inyawo yakho yonke kuL na R (L+R = inyawo yakho yonke).
Yipheni ngelithi lilodwa kwaloo mafu.

invalid_move.split_no_change: I-Split imele ukuba iyatshintsha indlela owahlula ngayo izandla zakho.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Khwelo lisiko. Sebenzisa “[attack M O]” okanye “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} ikhwaza P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: iyaphula ku{opp_val} ku〕{new_val}.
